editorial:
Ever feel like your personal life just disappears once you have a baby? That is exactly where you find yourself with Saverio, a new dad who realizes his bedroom life has become pretty boring. Instead of just ignoring it, he decides to film a documentary to see if other parents are struggling too. You get to follow him as he interviews different couples, and it is honestly pretty funny to see how everyone is basically in the same boat. The vibe is light and relatable, mixing awkward laughs with the real stress of keeping a relationship alive while dealing with diapers and sleepless nights.

What really works here is how honest the conversations feel. The acting is natural, and you will likely see yourself or your friends in these characters. While the pace is a bit slow in some spots, the humor keeps you interested. If you are a parent or planning to be one, you definitely need to see this. It is a great pick for a date night since it sparks a lot of good conversations. You can grab it for a rental on Apple TV or if you want the best quality, look for the 4K Blu-ray to add to your physical collection.
endingExplained: By the end of his project, Saverio realizes that the spark does not just vanish, it just changes shape. He learns that communication is the only way to fix the gap between him and his wife. The movie wraps up with the couple finally talking openly about their needs instead of hiding their frustrations. It ends on a hopeful note, showing that they can find a new balance between being great parents and being lovers.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves realistic stories about family life and relationships.
